verdict.rationale: Pulley's compliance product page says it handles ASC 718 reporting as part of the equity compliance work finance teams own. That is a first-party claim of the capability, but it is one marketing-level mention with no detail on report contents, expense calculation methods, exports, or audit readiness. missing for 10: documentation of ASC 718 expense report contents and methodology (e.g., grant-date fair value, amortization schedules, forfeitures), auditor-ready export formats, help-center how-to for generating the reports, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can produce ASC 718 stock-based compensation expense reports my accountants can hand to auditors

citations.quote: Pulley's equity compliance software handles the compliance work your finance team owns as you grow, from ASC 718 reporting and tax filings to board management.
